'''Jerome Flynn''' (also published as '''Jerry Flynn''') is a Star Wars CCG player from the Minneapolis area who played the Tuesday-night tournaments at Mirkwood. He played at [[August 2000 Minneapolis tournament]] on 22 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Joshua Grace's tournament report,<ref name="tr-d1158">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 25 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and finished 3rd at [[November 2000 Minneapolis tournament (28 November)]], according to Michael Raveling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1500">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ mirkwood-minnesota-2000], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 28 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-28-mirkwood-minnesota-2000d1500/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He travelled with the Minnesota group to the [[2001 Normal DPC]] and finished 7th.<ref name="tr-d1814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ normal-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
